entries.1f78373a43f7c31e: This business makes and sells components used in automobiles and other products. The main products are resin molded products, friction materials (components used in brakes and similar), powder metallurgy products and aluminum functional components. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥178,430 million, down 10.9% from ¥200,311 million in the previous year. This reflected the transfer of businesses including secondary battery packaging materials and food packaging materials in January–March, as well as lower demand from some domestic customers. Following an organizational change effective January 1, 2025, the energy storage and sliding materials business, whose main product is carbon anode materials, moved from this segment to Chemical.

Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥174,358 million, down 14.0% from ¥202,730 million in the previous year. Chemicals posted higher revenue on higher carbon dioxide volumes and price increases on some products, while graphite electrodes saw both sales volumes and selling prices fall due to weak market conditions. The energy storage and sliding materials business (carbon anode materials) was transferred from Mobility effective January 1, 2025, and prior-year figures are also disclosed on the new segment basis.

entries.cd13c601942cfcb3: These are materials used in the “front-end” process that forms semiconductor circuits. The main products are high-purity gases for electronic materials and polishing materials for flattening circuit surfaces (CMP slurry). In the fiscal year ended December 2025, revenue declined slightly, due to factors including the slow pace of recovery in NAND demand and the impact of the transfer of the exhaust gas treatment equipment business.
entries.d12d271188b1ff28: This segment handles the petrochemical business. The business is run by Kurasasu Chemical Co., Ltd., which received the absorption-type company split of the petrochemical business from the company and Resonac Corporation effective January 1, 2025, and makes and sells olefins, organic chemicals such as ethyl acetate, and synthetic resins. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥300,302 million, down 8.9% from ¥329,680 million in the previous year. This was because naphtha (a petrochemical feedstock) prices fell, lowering product selling prices.
entries.e5852e8805ec4e66: This business makes and sells resin materials, functional chemicals (synthetic resin emulsions, unsaturated polyester resins), coating materials, and ceramics (alumina, grinding and polishing materials, fine ceramics). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥92,202 million, down 4.9% from ¥97,001 million in the previous year. This was due to lower demand for some products, reflecting factors including the slump in the automotive market.
entries.e967736238ad7ea0: This business makes and sells materials used in semiconductor manufacturing processes and electronic devices such as recording media for hard disks (HD media). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥506,336 million, the largest of the five reportable segments, up 13.7% from ¥445,139 million in the previous year. This was the only one of the five segments to post higher revenue, mainly due to higher sales volumes of back-end materials for advanced semiconductors such as those used in AI.
